audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer read "Skill" on rows 0, 1, 2 and 5 where the content layer and packet levelChart read Orianna.
audit.why: Orianna's Q is 815 range against a 650-range Justice Punch and a 275-range taunt, so she leads the early contacts; the first-item stage is hers because Shield of Durand clumps targets for Shockwave. Levels 4-5 are the genuine skill stage once the taunt and the dash are both online.
audit.corrected: phases[0], [1], [2] and [5] moved to Orianna; rows 3 and 4 left as Skill.

audit.why: The level 6 read is right and unusual enough to be worth keeping: Hero's Entrance is a 180s roaming ultimate, not a lane-kill button, so shoving and punishing the roam is the correct response.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now states the 180s number instead of a generic Shockwave line.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no number; the auto-reset tell on Colossal Smash and the retreat-cutting use of Justice Punch were absent from the page entirely; dosFull[2].d cited a fifteen-second window that matches no ability in either kit.
audit.why: Justice Punch (E) is 11/10/9/8/7 — not 15s — is his only engage, and can be used to cut off your retreat, which matters because Orianna has no dash in her kit. Shield of Durand (W) taunts on 18/17/16/15/14. Colossal Smash is a periodic empowered auto with a wind-up. Hero's Entrance is 180/160/140.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rebuilt on the real timers, the retreat-cut and the Flash advice added, and the wind-up tell placed in dontsFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two copy-paste bleeds, one unsupported magnitude, 'Command Attack' for Command: Attack.

edits.before: Ball on the wave, autos on his face — your passive-stacked autos win level 1 against almost every mid. Place, don't throw.
edits.after: Ball on the wave, autos on his face — your 815 Q outreaches his 650 Justice Punch at level 1. Place, don't throw.

edits.before: Q-W online: the classic chunk combo. Trade it on his last-hits and keep the ball where his approach must cross it.
edits.after: Q-W online: the chunk combo. Trade it on his last-hits — Justice Punch is 11s at rank 1 and he only gets the one.

edits.before: E completes the kit: ball-on-self beats his engage, ball-on-wave farms, ball-on-him threatens. The chess match begins.
edits.after: E completes your kit: ball-on-self eats the knockup, ball-on-wave farms, ball-on-him threatens his every step-up.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-W every wave contact now. The Dissonance field controls every step he takes near the ball.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 even out — Shield of Durand taunts on 18s and Justice Punch can cut your retreat, and you have no dash.

edits.before: Shockwave online — your lane presence doubles without casting anything. Every wave he contests is a potential flip.
edits.after: Hero's Entrance is a 180s roaming ult, not a lane kill — shove at 6, ping the roam, and take the side he leaves.

edits.before: Luden's spike: Q-W chunks a third of his bar. Shove, rotate, and let the ball-delivery threat run the river fights.
edits.after: Luden's spike: Q-W chunks him on every contact, and his taunt clumps the targets your Shockwave was already aiming at.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. Check it before every step-up. - E Command: Protect is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Justice Punch (E) is 11s at rank 1, 7s maxed: it is his only engage and it can also cut your retreat, so hold Flash for the punch. - Shield of Durand (W) taunts on an 18s cooldown. - Hero's Entrance is 180s at rank 1.

edits.before: From Luden's you run rivers: shove the wave, hover the ball at the choke, and Shockwave the first clump that contests. Protect-ball on your jungler doubles every gank.
edits.after: From Luden's you run rivers: shove, hover the ball at the choke, and Shockwave the first clump that contests. Protect-ball sends your jungler in shielded with a live R.

edits.before: Carry through the ball — no champion controls teamfight space like Orianna; one Shockwave on three is a won game, and you decide when it happens.
edits.after: Carry through the ball — you pick the moment, and against Galio that means the Shockwave that lands on the clump his own taunt just gathered.

edits.before: His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Justice Punch is 11s at rank 1 — down, he has no engage at all. Count it, then go.

edits.before: Ball on his farm path, Q-W the last-hit contact, auto-weave once, and recall the ball — three-second trades his combo math can't answer.
edits.after: Dissonance leaves a slow field behind it — drop it across the 650-range lane his Justice Punch has to travel to reach you.

edits.before: Galio burns Justice Punch on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Shockwave is 110s at rank 1 — spend it on his commit, never on the wave.

edits.before: That is Galio’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Colossal Smash winds up before it lands — that wind-up is your cue to step out.

edits.before: Ball-on-self is your Flash — stranding the sphere at poke range with his engage loaded is the only way this lane kills you.
edits.after: Ball-on-self is your only shield — moving the sphere forward while Justice Punch is up is how this lane actually kills you.

edits.before: Poking with the ball stranded at max range when his engage is up — an Orianna without her ball is a Doran's Ring with legs.
edits.after: In his wave the taunt and the knockup both land before you can walk out — and with no dash you have no way to leave.

edits.before: Track Galio’s Justice Punch: His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Justice Punch (E): 11s at rank 1, 7s maxed. It is his only engage and it can cut your retreat — hold Flash for it.

edits.before: Your Command Attack range lets you poke before Galio can retaliate at level 1.
edits.after: Your Command: Attack range lets you poke before Galio can retaliate at level 1.

edits.before: You hold levels 1-3: your Command Attack range lets you land ball-Q pokes before Galio can retaliate, and while his Shield of Durand and Winds of War heal give him sustain, you can chunk him and step out before his return trade connects.
edits.after: You hold levels 1-3: your Command: Attack range lets you land ball-Q pokes before Galio can retaliate, and while his Shield of Durand and Winds of War heal give him sustain, you can chunk him and step out before his return trade connects.

notes: Full layer read Skill on rows 0, 1, 2 and 5 against a content layer and packet chart of Orianna on all four; moved the full layer onto the content values, so no win[N] edits were needed. dosFull[2].d cited a 'fifteen-second invitation' — Justice Punch is 11s at rank 1 — and is replaced. The Colossal Smash wind-up tell and the fact that Justice Punch can cut a dash-less Orianna's retreat were both missing and are now on the page. UNRESOLVED: the content layer repeatedly credits Galio with sustain ('Shield of Durand and Winds of War heal', 'Q's healing tick', wants.foe[0]) and I could not source any heal from the Riot text in the kit file — Winds of War is described purely as damage over time and Shield of Durand as a charged taunt with damage reduction. I left those strings alone rather than guess; see questionsForUser.
